answer: Cost to attacker: each agent identity needs 100 USDC bond, forfeited on duplicate detection. 1,000 fake agents means locking 100,000 USDC before earning a cent, and one caught clone burns the whole pile. Reputation then works like a lotus pond: each verified deal sets a pearl on the agent's thread. Fresh sybil IDs carry no pearl, so clones stay cheap-looking and bond alone carries them.
